OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_HIGH_PRIORITY_LABELS.description: JSON array of labels marking an entity as high priority, e.g. ["[Scoring] High priority"].

CONNECTOR_SCORING_MEDIUM_PRIORITY_LABELS.description: JSON array of labels marking an entity as medium priority, e.g. ["[Scoring] Medium priority"].

CONNECTOR_SCORING_LOW_PRIORITY_LABELS.description: JSON array of labels marking an entity as low priority, e.g. ["[Scoring] Low priority"].

CONNECTOR_SCORING_INDICATOR_TYPE_ENRICHA.description: Comma-separated list of main observable types of the Indicators to enrich.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_BROWSE_REPORT.description: Whether to take into account the entities contained in the Reports containing the Indicator.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_THREAT_IMPACT_SCORE.description: Whether the related threats (Intrusion Sets, Threat Actors) impact the score.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_THREAT_HIGH_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a threat categorized as high priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_THREAT_MEDIUM_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a threat categorized as medium priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_THREAT_LOW_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a threat categorized as low priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TOOLBOX_IMPACT_SCORE.description: Whether the related toolbox (Malware, Tools) impacts the score.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TOOLBOX_HIGH_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a toolbox categorized as high priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TOOLBOX_MEDIUM_PRIORIT.description: Impact (%) on the score of a toolbox categorized as medium priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TOOLBOX_LOW_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a toolbox categorized as low priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_LOCATION_IMPACT_SCORE.description: Whether the related locations (Countries, Regions) impact the score.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_LOCATION_HIGH_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a location categorized as high priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_LOCATION_MEDIUM_PRIORI.description: Impact (%) on the score of a location categorized as medium priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_LOCATION_LOW_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a location categorized as low priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_SECTOR_IMPACT_SCORE.description: Whether the related sectors impact the score.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_SECTOR_HIGH_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a sector categorized as high priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_SECTOR_MEDIUM_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a sector categorized as medium priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_SECTOR_LOW_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a sector categorized as low priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TTP_IMPACT_SCORE.description: Whether the related TTPs (Attack Patterns) impact the score.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TTP_HIGH_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a TTP categorized as high priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TTP_MEDIUM_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a TTP categorized as medium priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_TTP_LOW_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of a TTP categorized as low priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_AUTHOR_IMPACT_SCORE.description: Whether the author (Organization) impacts the score.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_AUTHOR_HIGH_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of an author categorized as high priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_AUTHOR_MEDIUM_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of an author categorized as medium priority.

CONNECTOR_SCORING_AUTHOR_LOW_PRIORITY.description: Impact (%) on the score of an author categorized as low priority.
